description: This file defines the OrderService class, which implements the IOrderService interface. It provides functionality to create new orders from a user's basket, including fetching basket and catalog data, validating the basket contents, and constructing an order entity.

classes.name: OrderService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling order creation, interacting with repositories and specifications to process basket data into an order.

methods.name: CreateOrderAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates an order based on the basket ID and shipping address, fetching basket and catalog data, validating it, and persisting a new order entity.
